name: context-mode
description: MCP server that keeps raw tool output out of your context window — 315 KB of benchmarked output comes back as 5.4 KB (98% reduction), with session continuity across compactions. Sandboxed code execution in 12 languages, FTS5 knowledge base with BM25 ranking, fused project-wide search, and codegraph-backed structural queries. Fork of mksglu/context-mode.
